headline: 10 injured, including 4 journalists, in Chhatra Dal attack at RU
summary: Journalists demand the arrest of attackers and cancellation of student status for those involved in the assault at Rajshahi University.
details: At least 10 people, including four journalists, were injured in an attack by members of the Jatiyatabadi Chhatra Dal (JCD) at Rajshahi University on Sunday night.

The incident occurred around 8:30 PM in front of the Shaheed President Ziaur Rahman Hall. Among the injured journalists are representatives from bdnews24.com, Agamir Somoy, The Daily Star, and Somkal.
Following the attack, campus journalists gathered at the Provost's office of Ziaur Rahman Hall to present a three-point demand to the university administration.

The demands include filing a case against the attackers, ensuring the arrest of the accused by Monday noon, and canceling the student status or certificates of those involved who are students of the university.
They also demanded that non-students involved in the attack be banned from entering the campus. The administration has assured them that a case will be filed by Monday.
Allegations have been leveled against JCD vice president Ahsan Habib and several other activists for their involvement in the assault.
caption:
10 people, including 4 journalists, injured in a Chhatra Dal attack at Rajshahi University. Journalists are now demanding immediate arrests and strict punishment.

At least 10 people, including four journalists, were injured in an attack by members of the Jatiyatabadi Chhatra Dal (JCD) at Rajshahi University on Sunday night.

The incident occurred around 8:30 PM in front of the Shaheed President Ziaur Rahman Hall. Among the injured journalists are representatives from bdnews24.com, Agamir Somoy, The Daily Star, and Somkal.

Following the attack, campus journalists gathered at the Provost's office of Ziaur Rahman Hall to present a three-point demand to the university administration.

The demands include filing a case against the attackers, ensuring the arrest of the accused by Monday noon, and canceling the student status or certificates of those involved who are students of the university.

They also demanded that non-students involved in the attack be banned from entering the campus. The administration has assured them that a case will be filed by Monday.

Allegations have been leveled against JCD vice president Ahsan Habib and several other activists for their involvement in the assault.

#RajshahiUniversity #PressFreedom #Bangladesh #JCD #CampusViolence

Source: Jamuna TV, Dhaka Tribune, The Daily Star

headline: 1,430 applicants per post: Government job competition intensifies in Bangladesh
summary: Over 2.1 million people applied for 1,485 positions at the Department of Social Services, highlighting a severe job crisis for youth.
details: Over 2.1 million candidates applied for just 1,485 positions at the Department of Social Services, meaning an average of 1,430 applicants per single post.
caption:
